cards.text: Friend, Moses, Israel's leader, is still preaching to the people. They're standing right outside the land the LORD swore to give their fathers. Now Moses tells them to carefully follow every commandment he's giving them today.

cards.question: Moses tells Israel to carefully follow every commandment. What does he say that will lead to?

answers.text: They will live and multiply and possess the land
They will build a great temple for the LORD
They will rule over every nation on the earth

cards.text: Then Moses tells them to remember that for FORTY YEARS the LORD led them all the way through the wilderness. Forty years, friend, and I get impatient when the oven takes twelve minutes to preheat.

cards.question: Moses says the LORD led Israel through the wilderness so He might ___ them and ___ them, to know what was in their heart.

cards.text: The LORD humbled them. Then in their hunger, He fed them something brand new that they and their fathers had never known, and it came with a lesson.

cards.question: In Israel's hunger, the LORD gave them ___ to eat.
Moses says the manna was meant to teach Israel that people don't live on bread alone. What else do they live on?

answers.text: Every word from the mouth of the LORD
Whatever they can gather each morning
The bread their fathers ate in Egypt

cards.text: Jesus answers the devil with this same truth when He's tempted in the wilderness (Matthew 4:4). That's how much this one line matters, friend.

cards.question: Forty years of walking through the wilderness. True or false: Moses says Israel's clothing did not wear out the whole time.

cards.text: Their feet didn't swell either, after FORTY YEARS of walking! Friend, I wore my edges down just stamping cookies on a kitchen counter.
Then Moses explains all of it with a picture everybody understands.

cards.question: Moses says that just as a man disciplines his ___, so the LORD disciplines Israel.

cards.text: So Moses says keep the LORD's commandments, walking in His ways and fearing Him. Because the LORD is bringing them into a good land.

cards.question: After a thirsty wilderness, what does Moses say flows through the valleys and hills of the good land?

cards.text: It's a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey. That's like going from one plain sugar cookie to a whole tray with chocolate chips, sprinkles AND butterscotch bits.

cards.question: In the good land, Israel will eat food without scarcity. What does Moses say they will lack?
Even the ground in this land is rich. True or false: Moses says its hills are ready to be mined for gold.
When Israel eats and is satisfied in the good land, what does Moses say they are to do?

answers.text: Bless the LORD for the land

cards.text: Now Moses gets serious: be careful not to forget the LORD your God by not keeping His commandments. I've forgotten a batch in the oven, sure, but forgetting GOD?

cards.question: Moses warns Israel about a time when forgetting the LORD could sneak in. When is it?

answers.text: When they are full and rich and settled
When enemies surround them in battle
When a famine strikes the land

cards.text: Full plates, fine houses, bigger herds and flocks, MORE silver and MORE gold. Sounds like a dream, right, but listen to what Moses says comes next.

cards.question: With all that wealth, Moses says their heart will become ___.
True or false: Moses reminds Israel that the LORD brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

cards.text: The LORD led them through a vast and terrifying wilderness with venomous SNAKES and SCORPIONS, a thirsty land with no water. Friend, I jumped when a rubber band snapped in my old junk drawer.

cards.question: In that thirsty and waterless land, where did the LORD bring Israel water from?

cards.text: He fed them with manna their fathers had never known, to humble them and test them. That line again, friend, but this time Moses tells them where it was all going.

cards.question: The LORD humbled and tested Israel so that in the end He might cause them to ___.

cards.text: Then Moses names a thought that could creep into their heart once the wealth rolls in.

cards.question: What thought does Moses warn Israel they might say in their heart?

answers.text: My own strength made this wealth
Our fathers earned all of this
The land was always ours to keep

cards.question: True or false: Moses tells Israel to remember that the power to gain wealth comes from their own hands.
Moses says the LORD gives Israel the power to gain wealth. Why does He give it?

answers.text: To confirm His covenant with their fathers
To make the nations jealous of Israel
To pay for offerings at the tabernacle

cards.text: Then Moses gets as serious as it gets. If they ever forget the LORD and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, he testifies against them today.

cards.question: If Israel goes after other gods, what does Moses testify will happen to them?

answers.text: They will wander forty more years
They will lose half of the land

cards.question: Moses says if Israel does not obey the LORD, they will perish like the ___ the LORD destroyed before them.

cards.text: Strong words, friend, and Moses means every one of them. But he's not done preaching, not even close.
